tr: ve-lo qam navi od be-yisrael ke-moshe asher yeda-o YHWH panim el panim
en: and-not arise prophet still/again in-Israel like-Moses which know-him/its YHWH face to face
fen: And there hath not arisen a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face;

he: לכל האתות והמופתים אשר שלחו יהוה לעשות בארץ מצרים לפרעה ולכל עבדיו ולכל ארצו
tr: le-khal ha-otot ve-ha-moftim asher shelach-o YHWH la-asot be-eretz mitzrayim le-faro u-le-khal avaday-v u-le-khal artz-o
en: to-all the-signs and-the-miracle which send-him/its YHWH to-make in-earth Egypt to-Pharaoh and-to-all servant-him/its and-to-all earth-him/its
fen: in all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

he: ולכל היד החזקה ולכל המורא הגדול אשר עשה משה לעיני כל ישראל
tr: u-le-khol ha-yad ha-chazaqa u-le-khol ha-mora ha-gadol asher asa moshe le-ene kal yisrael
en: and-to-all the-hand the-strong and-to-all the-fear the-great which make Moses to-eye all Israel
fen: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the great terror, which Moses wrought in the sight of all Israel.
